snippet.title: Bagels Game (1972) – Mainframe Game
snippet.description:
Another guess the number game, mastermind edition.  The computer picks a 3-digit secret number and you attempt to guess what it is. You are allowed up to twenty guesses. No digit is repeated. After each guess the computer will give you clues about your guess.

This game is called Bagels and comes from "101 BASIC Computer Games".  In the manual and original program the game was titled BAGLES.

Program Authors: D. Resek, P. Rowe

MobyGames entry: https://www.mobygames.com/game/63104/bagels/
